notes.title: Update – New Features & Improvements
notes.content:
Release Date: May 13, 2025

This update includes the addition of cheat functionality, improved level progression UI, window size adjustments, and a fix for a missing intro message translation. See below for more details:

⸻

New Features

Cheats? Just a puzzle excuse – Cheat Function Added

 A [Level Clear] button has been added below the [Retry] button on the failure screen.
 Pressing this button will mark the current level as completed, then transition to the success screen and reward image screen.
 If there are remaining levels, the game will automatically proceed to the next one.


Next Level Button Added

 A [Next Level] button has been added to the reward image screen after clearing a level.
 This button is only active during stage progression and is disabled when accessed from the gallery.


Block Deck Refresh Key Added

 During gameplay, pressing the [D key] will now refresh the block deck.


⸻

Improvements

Resizable Game Window

 The window size has been adjusted to prevent the game from being obscured by the taskbar in certain environments.


⸻

Bug Fixes

Missing Intro Message Translations Fixed

 Previously, the intro message was displayed only in English.
 It now appears correctly in all supported languages.

notes.title: Indulgentia – The Puzzle That Will Seduce and Addict You Begins Now!
notes.content:
The wait is over.

With 400 puzzle stages, 10 irresistible characters, and 240 provocative illustrations,
Indulgentia — a sexy, addictive story-driven puzzle game — is finally here!

400 Puzzle Stages – Push Your Limits

This isn’t just about stacking and clearing blocks.
Test your strategy, speed, and focus across 400 increasingly challenging stages.
As you progress, the difficulty rises—
and new layers of each character’s story begin to unfold.
If you expected a simple puzzle game… think again.

10 Captivating Characters – Your Choices Define the Game

Each of the 10 female characters has a unique personality, style, and preference.
Some are cold and confident. Others are playful… or shy.
Who’s your type? Only one way to find out.

240 Erotic Illustrations – A Bold and Thrilling Narrative

This is far from your average puzzle game.
Unlock illustrations, deepen your relationships, and uncover an exciting, ever-evolving story.
Temptation, tension, and forbidden moments await…
all brought to life with 240 high-quality erotic artworks.

Play Now

This game is more than just simple controls.
Addictive puzzles, charming characters, and a dangerously captivating story.
Indulgentia invites you to step into a world shaped by your own choices.
